source_doc.title: Global Semi Research: Co-Packaged Optics Is Not Delayed. SemiAnalysis Is Just Wrong — CPO 延遲論戰(含 SemiAnalysis「Powered Down, Lights Off」主張之轉述)
source_doc.permission_basis: 公開 Substack 文章;僅保存研究所需之有限逐字引文於 library/raw 與本 extraction。SemiAnalysis 原報告(2026-06-09)為付費內容且未獨立取得,其主張以本文轉述為準(honest passthrough,不得計為第二 origin)。

sources.quote: On June 9, SemiAnalysis published 'Powered Down, Lights Off'

sources.locator: SemiAnalysis 主張轉述(原報告未獨立取得)
sources.quote: scale-out CPO shipments revised down through 2027, scale-up pushed to 2029

sources.locator: SemiAnalysis 主張轉述,Spectrum-6 技術問題
sources.quote: Spectrum 6 reportedly showed more than 3.5 dB of insertion loss in system-level testing

sources.locator: GSR 供應鏈查核,CW 雷射 guidance
sources.quote: Nvidia's guidance to Coherent and Lumentum for high-power CW lasers climbed from roughly 40 million units in January to about 100 million units by April and May
Lumentum does not book out an entire FA production line, for a technology that is supposedly delivering 'meaningfully below prior expectations.'

sources.locator: GSR 反駁,良率算法批判
sources.quote: freezes yield at one pessimistic snapshot and raises it to the 32nd power as though yield never improves.

claims.statement: 反向 thesis 存證(honest passthrough,SemiAnalysis 原報告付費未獨立取得,主張依 GSR 轉述):SemiAnalysis「Powered Down, Lights Off」(2026-06-09)主張 CPO 時程延遲——scale-out 出貨下修至 2027、scale-up 推遲到 2029,Spectrum-6 系統級測試 insertion loss >3.5dB。此為對本圖 CPO 需求 thesis 的最強公開反駁,發布當日 LITE/COHR/AAOI 等光通股大跌。
claims.disproof_condition: NVIDIA/Broadcom 官方確認 CPO 出貨時程未變(如 Spectrum-6 如期量產出貨),或 SemiAnalysis 撤回/修正報告,或取得原報告全文顯示主張與轉述不符。

claims.statement: GSR 反駁 SemiAnalysis 延遲論:CPO is not being delayed——供應端產能承諾與延遲敘事矛盾(Lumentum 不會為一個「明顯低於預期」的技術 book out 整條 FA 產線),且 SemiAnalysis 的 0.95^32≈19% 系統良率算法把良率凍結在悲觀單點、忽略良率學習曲線。
claims.disproof_condition: Spectrum-6 CPO 官方出貨時程正式下修 2 季以上,或 Coherent/Lumentum 撤回 2027 scale-up 出貨承諾/砍產能。

claims.statement: Dated observation(GSR 供應鏈查核,截至 2026-06-10):NVIDIA 對 Coherent 與 Lumentum 的 high-power CW 雷射 guidance 由 1 月約 40M 顆攀升至 4-5 月約 100M 顆——需求前置訊號,亦為 Coherent/Lumentum→NVIDIA 雷射供應關係的第一個非當事方(GSR)佐證。
claims.disproof_condition: 後續供應鏈查核或公司揭露顯示 guidance 被下修/正常化,或證實 40M→100M 數字失實。
